title: Null-measurability of M_t, local integrability of θ on M_t and a.e. strong measurability of ξ_t for a.e. t
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m+1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel measurable, L ≥ 0 and G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P Borel measurable with |G(x)| ≤ L for all x. Write Hᵏ := μHE[k] and assume the co-area identity for (M, f, G): for every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} g dH^m is L¹-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} g dH^m dt = ∫_M |G| g dHⁿ. For t ∈ ℝ let M_t := {x ∈ M : f(x) = t, G(x) ≠ 0} and ξ_t(x) := ξ(x) ∘ ι(|G(x)|⁻¹G(x)), where ι(v) := (alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ ℝ^P ℝ) ∘ (smulRightL ℝ ℝ^P Λ^m (innerSL ℝ v)) : Λ^m → Λ^{m+1} (ι(v)α = v♭∧α). Then for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ: (a) M_t is H^m-null-measurable; (b) θ is H^m-integrable on M_t ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U; (c) ξ_t is a.e. strongly measurable for H^m restricted to M_t.
